personas.title: Upwell Structures: Anchoring, Quantum Core, Tethering, Docking, Fitting, Services, Take Control & Unanchoring
personas.description: End-to-end Upwell structure lifecycle playthrough: (1) Prerequisites & Anchoring: ensure the pilot belongs to a player corporation (create one via Corporation window if in NPC starter corp), grant Anchoring (3443) + Corporation Management (3731) skills, spawn an Astrahus (35832) + Astrahus Upwell Quantum Core (56201) (or Raitaru 35825 + Raitaru Upwell Quantum Core 56204) into a hauler/capital or ship cargo, move to a non-trade-hub system where Upwell deployment is permitted ('/moveme 30000144' Perimeter or '/moveme 30000140' Maurasi — NEVER attempt to deploy in Jita 30000142, where CCP static data blocks categoryStructure with UserError CantDeployBlocked) and move >1,000 km from stations/stargates/asteroids (note: /tr only accepts [me|<char_id>] <location_id>, never 'pos x y z'; warp toward a distant planet/stargate and press Stop Ship mid-warp for a clean deep-space safe spot), right-click the structure in cargo -> 'Launch for Corporation', position & click Anchor; (2) Timer Advancement & Quantum Core Installation: run advance_upwell_timer ('/upwelltimer') to advance AnchorVulnerable -> Anchoring -> NoCore, dock inside the structure or open Structure Transfer / Core Room, deposit the Quantum Core (56201 / 56204) into the Core Room (flag 180 / StructureDeedBay), and run advance_upwell_timer ('/upwelltimer') again to advance Onlining -> ShieldVulnerable (Online); (3) Tethering, Docking, Fitting & Services: undock to verify Tethering ('effects.StructureRepair' / tethered buff in space), dock inside the Upwell structure ('session.structure_id' set, 'structureHangarView'), open Fitting while docked or controlling to fit a Standup service module (e.g. Standup Cloning Center I 35894 or Standup Market Hub I 35892) + Fuel Blocks (4051 / 4247) in Structure Fuel Bay and online the service; (4) Structure Control & Management: click 'Take Control' ('structureControl.TakeControl') to board/control the structure defenses in space, then 'Relinquish Control' ('ReleaseControl'), inspect Structure Browser ('structurebrowser') & Access Lists/Profiles, and test 'Decommission' ('structureDeployment.Unanchor' / 'CancelUnanchor').
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Anchor & Quantum Core Online): In a player corp in a non-restricted solar system ('/moveme 30000144' Perimeter or '/moveme 30000140' Maurasi — NOT Jita 30000142 which raises CantDeployBlocked) at >1,000 km from stations/gates (warp toward a distant planet/gate and press CTRL+SPACE Stop Ship mid-warp, or '/tr me <celestial_id>'; do NOT pass 'pos x y z' to /tr), deploy an Astrahus (35832) or Raitaru (35825) via 'Launch for Corporation', use advance_upwell_timer ('/upwelltimer') through AnchorVulnerable -> Anchoring -> NoCore, install the matching Quantum Core (56201 or 56204), and run advance_upwell_timer ('/upwelltimer') to reach ShieldVulnerable.

Checkpoint 2 (Tethering, Structure Docking, Fitting & Service Module Online): Verify tethering outside the online Upwell structure, dock inside it (verifying session.structure_id is populated), load Fuel Blocks (4051/4247), fit & online a Standup service module (e.g. 35894 Standup Cloning Center I or 35892 Standup Market Hub I), and inspect the newly enabled structure service.

Checkpoint 3 (Take Control, Structure Browser & Decommission): Exercise 'Take Control' (structureControl.TakeControl) to assume gunnery/structure control and 'Relinquish Control' (ReleaseControl), inspect Structure Browser ('structurebrowser') / Structure Profiles, and initiate or cancel Unanchoring.

personas.title: Titans & Capital Warfare: Nullsec Deployment, Doomsday Superweapons, Phenomena Generators, Jump Portal & Jump Drive
personas.description: End-to-end Titan supercapital playthrough in nullsec space: (1) Nullsec Deployment & Titan Boarding: move to a nullsec system ('/moveme 30004759' 1DQ1-A or '/moveme 30000197' HED-GP — Titans cannot be boarded in highsec and Doomsdays cannot fire in highsec/lowsec), grant Titan & Doomsday skills ('/giveskill 3347 5' Amarr Titan, '/giveskill 3346 5' Gallente Titan, '/giveskill 3344 5' Caldari Titan, '/giveskill 3345 5' Minmatar Titan, '/giveskill 24563 5' Doomsday Operation, '/giveskill 24562 5' Jump Portal Generation, '/giveskill 3433 5' Jump Drive Operation, '/giveskill 20533 5' Capital Ships), and spawn/board an Avatar (11567) or Erebus (671) in space ('/spawn 11567' + right-click Board, or '/fit me ...'); (2) Superweapon, Phenomena Generator & Bridge Fitting: fit a single-target Doomsday ('/fit me 24550' 'Judgment' Electromagnetic Doomsday on Avatar 11567, or '/fit me 24554' 'Aurora Ominae' Thermal Doomsday on Erebus 671), a Phenomena Generator ('/fit me 43658' Amarr Phenomena Generator), or Jump Portal Generator I ('/fit me 23953'), and load fuel into cargo/fuel bay ('/createitem 16274 50000' Helium Isotopes, '/createitem 16275 5000' Strontium Clathrates, '/createitem 17889 50000' Hydrogen Isotopes); (3) Capital Target Lock & Doomsday Activation: set Crimewatch safety to Red ('crimewatch.SetSafetyLevel(0)'), ensure ship is not tethered/cloaked, spawn a capital target ('/spawn 19720' Revelation Dreadnought or '/spawn 19724' Moros — single-target Doomsdays can ONLY fire on Capital/Supercapital ships or Structures within <200 km), lock the capital target ('lock_target'), and activate the Doomsday module ('activate_module') verifying massive EM/Thermal damage, OnGodmaShipEffect 'superWeapon', fuel consumption, and 30s self-immobilization / 300s jump-dock lock; (4) Phenomena Generator & Capital Jump Navigation: test Phenomena Generator fleet/system buff activation or Jump Drive / Jump Portal UI inspection, then switch back to a subcapital ship before returning to highsec.
goals: Checkpoint 1 (Nullsec Deployment, Titan Boarding & Superweapon Fit): Teleport to nullsec ('/moveme 30004759'), grant Titan + Doomsday Operation (24563) + Capital Ships (20533) skills, board an Avatar (11567) or Erebus (671), fit 'Judgment' Electromagnetic Doomsday (24550) + Amarr Phenomena Generator (43658), and load Helium Isotopes (16274) + Strontium Clathrates (16275).

Checkpoint 2 (Capital Target Lock & Doomsday Firing): Spawn a capital target ('/spawn 19720' Revelation Dreadnought) within <200 km in nullsec (not tethered, safety Red), lock the target, and fire the Doomsday superweapon (24550) verifying damage messages, isotope consumption, and superweapon cycle effects.

Checkpoint 3 (Phenomena Generator / Capital Systems & Cleanup): Activate the Phenomena Generator (43658) or inspect Jump Portal / Capital Navigation state, then board a subcapital ship and return to highsec cleanly.
